selection_rule.exclude_prior_target_ways: Exclude every target way in the prior active-ray, fresh four-target, reference-portal, node-credential, and open-set-negative sources.
selection_rule.exclude_prior_items: Exclude every materialized or source-carried item in those sources plus both Le Viviani references.
selection_rule.collection_pair: For every eligible collection choose its item nearest 30 metres. Select the collection pair with the smallest absolute distance difference, tie by collection IDs. The lexicographically first collection is reference and the other is query.
selection_rule.reference_items: Within the frozen reference collection, sequentially choose the unused item nearest 5 metres then the unused item nearest 30 metres, tie by item ID.
selection_rule.query_item: Use the frozen query-collection representative nearest 30 metres.
selection_rule.panel: After all prior target-way exclusions, require exactly two eligible cross-collection targets and sort them by target-way ID and query item ID.
forbidden_inputs: selected full, SD, thumbnail, tile, or derived pixels
OCR, CLIP, DINOv2, or any learned-model output on selected images
selected-image top-1 score, margin, acceptance, or failure

accept_contract_frozen_before_pixels.calibration_source: The four source-extended positive episodes in l10_panolab_component_router_result_v1.json.
accept_contract_frozen_before_pixels.threshold_rule: Reuse the exact minimum positive score and margin frozen before the open-set negative panel; do not recalibrate on these selected positives.
accept_contract_frozen_before_pixels.accept: The requested target must rank unique top-1 among the combined old-plus-new roster and meet both thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
accept_contract_frozen_before_pixels.semantics: Search-priority candidate only; never physical identity or portal ownership authority.
